overview: The building plans distinguish blocks A and B. Their legends add two-bedroom maid/store variants and three- and four-bedroom store variants to the brochure’s broader four-family selection.
research.locationNote: The developer identifies Dubai Islands. Waterfront positioning does not establish a guaranteed view or direct beach access for a selected apartment.
research.priceNote: The developer currently advertises AED 4,278,811, rounded to AED 4.3 million in its FAQ. This is a starting reference, subject to the selected unit and written availability confirmation.
research.paymentNote: Published schedule: 40% during construction and 60% after handover, paid at 2% monthly for 30 months. Both branded payment editions match the current developer page; the documents expressly allow changes.
research.handoverNote: The current developer anticipates Q4 2027. Mitchell’s attributes an earlier 31 March 2027 target to its dated project-register extract; neither forecast is evidence of completed handover.
